newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ cuts NZ 3-yr fixed mortgage rate to 10.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: ANZ cuts NZ 3-yr fixed mortgage rate to 10.25 pct.

text.p: ANZ Banking Group (NZ) Ltd and its PostBank subsidiary said on Tuesday they would cut their three-year fixed mortgage interest rate to 10.25 percent from 10.50 percent.
The rate applies to new applications received from August 28.
The variable rate remains at 11.50 percent per annum and the one year fixed rate is at 10.65 percent per annum.
ANZ said the cut came on the back of recent declines in wholesale interest rates.
